fit_STLFModel: fit an STLFModel with STL decomposition and a Prophet or linear forecasting method on time series data
predict_STLFModel: predict future values using a fitted STLFModel and return a DataFrame with forecast and confidence intervals
deseasonalize_STLFModel: deseasonalize time series data using STL decomposition and store seasonal and trend components in the model
create_STLFParams: create STLFParams to configure the forecasting method, seasonality period, decomposition type, and LOESS smoother settings
get_parameter_search_space_STLFModel: get the default parameter search space for hyperparameter tuning of the STLF forecasting model
